description: This file defines the interface for encoding and decoding various data types (such as int32, uint32, uint16, and strings) used in RTT messaging, including function declarations for encoding and decoding routines with associated error handling.

methods.name: rtEncoder_EncodeInt32
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit signed integer into a buffer.

methods.name: rtEncoder_DecodeInt32
methods.description: Decodes a 32-bit signed integer from a buffer.

methods.name: rtEncoder_EncodeUInt32
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit unsigned integer into a buffer.

methods.name: rtEncoder_DecodeUInt32
methods.description: Decodes a 32-bit unsigned integer from a buffer.

methods.name: rtEncoder_EncodeUInt16
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit unsigned integer into a buffer.

methods.name: rtEncoder_DecodeUInt16
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit unsigned integer from a buffer.

methods.name: rtEncoder_DecodeStr
methods.description: Decodes a string from a buffer into a provided buffer space.

methods.name: rtEncoder_EncodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string into a buffer.

methods.name: rtEncoder_DecodeString
methods.description: Decodes a string from a buffer into a provided buffer.
